Add pulmonary vascular resistance

Source: R/add_pvr.R
add_pvr.Rd

Computes pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) from right heart catheterization values recorded at listing or at transplant for heart, lung and heart-lung candidates, and appends it (default column PVR): PVR = (mean pulmonary artery pressure - pulmonary capillary wedge pressure) / cardiac output.

Usage

add_pvr(
  df,
  at = c("listing", "transplant"),
  units = c("wood", "dyn"),
  pvr_col = "PVR"
)

Arguments

df

A data frame of candidates or recipients, one row each.

at

Use the values recorded at "listing" (default) or at "transplant".

units

"wood" (default) for Wood units (mmHg min/L), or "dyn" for dyn s cm\(^{-5}\), Wood units times 80. The exact conversion from the unit definitions is 79.99; 80 is the conventional factor.

pvr_col

Name of the output column.

Value

df with a new column.

Details

Input columns, in mmHg and L/min:

atMean PA pressureWedge pressureCardiac output
"listing"CAN_PULM_ART_MEANCAN_PCW_MEANCAN_CARDIAC_OUTPUT
"transplant"REC_PULM_ART_MEANREC_PCW_MEANREC_CARDIAC_OUTPUT

A cardiac output of zero or less gives a missing PVR. The SAFs also record whether each reading was taken on inotropes or vasodilators (the *_MEDS columns); this function does not use them, so filter on them first if that matters.

References

Humbert M, Kovacs G, Hoeper MM, et al. 2022 ESC/ERS Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary hypertension. Eur Heart J 2022;43:3618-3731. doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehac237 (Section 5.1.12.1 and Table 11.)

See also

Guides:

  • The scores

  • Missing and unknown inputs

Examples

candidates <- data.frame(
  CAN_PULM_ART_MEAN = c(40, 25),
  CAN_PCW_MEAN = c(20, 15),
  CAN_CARDIAC_OUTPUT = c(4, 5)
)
add_pvr(candidates)
#>   CAN_PULM_ART_MEAN CAN_PCW_MEAN CAN_CARDIAC_OUTPUT PVR
#> 1                40           20                  4   5
#> 2                25           15                  5   2
